mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_weather_air_quality ( station_id, T1H, RN1, PTY, VEC, WSD, so2Value, coValue, o3Value, no2Value, pm10Value, khaiValue, khaiGrade, so2Grade, coGrade, o3Grade, no2Grade, pm10Grade, so2Flag, coFlag, o3Flag, no2Flag, pm10Flag,REH, recorded_at ) VALUES ( #{stationId}, #{T1H}, #{RN1}, #{PTY}, #{VEC}, #{WSD}, #{so2Value}, #{coValue}, #{o3Value}, #{no2Value}, #{pm10Value}, #{khaiValue}, #{khaiGrade}, #{so2Grade}, #{coGrade}, #{o3Grade}, #{no2Grade}, #{pm10Grade}, #{so2Flag}, #{coFlag}, #{o3Flag}, #{no2Flag}, #{pm10Flag}, #{REH}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT station_id, T1H, RN1, PTY, VEC, WSD, so2Value, coValue, o3Value, no2Value, pm10Value, khaiValue, khaiGrade, so2Grade, coGrade, o3Grade, no2Grade, pm10Grade, so2Flag, coFlag, o3Flag, no2Flag, pm10Flag,REH, DATE_FORMAT(recorded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS recorded_at FROM tb_weather_air_quality ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT station_id, T1H, RN1, PTY, VEC, WSD, so2Value, coValue, o3Value, no2Value, pm10Value, khaiValue, khaiGrade, so2Grade, coGrade, o3Grade, no2Grade, pm10Grade, so2Flag, coFlag, o3Flag, no2Flag, pm10Flag,REH, recorded_at FROM tb_weather_air_quality WHERE recorded_at > #{date} ORDER BY recorded_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.station_id, s.is_active, s.use_yn, s.updated_at, s.display_name, s.display_description, s.sno, w.recorded_at, CASE s.display_name WHEN 'T1H' THEN CONCAT(w.T1H, ' °C') WHEN 'RN1' THEN CONCAT(w.RN1, ' mm') WHEN 'REH' THEN CONCAT(w.REH, ' %') WHEN 'WSD' THEN CONCAT(w.WSD, ' m/s') WHEN 'so2Value' THEN CONCAT(w.so2Value, ' ppm') WHEN 'coValue' THEN CONCAT(w.coValue, ' ppm') WHEN 'o3Value' THEN CONCAT(w.o3Value, ' ppm') WHEN 'no2Value' THEN CONCAT(w.no2Value, ' ppm') WHEN 'pm10Value' THEN CONCAT(w.pm10Value, ' μg/m³') WHEN 'khaiValue' THEN CONCAT(w.khaiValue, ' μg/m³') ELSE NULL END AS current_value FROM tb_weather_air_quality_status s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tb_weather_air_quality ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) w ON s.station_id = w.station_id ORDER BY sno
